packageRules.description: Pin GitHub Actions to immutable commit SHAs. A floating tag is a mutable reference to code that runs with repository credentials. Scoped to github-actions: npm packages already carry integrity hashes in the lockfile.

Freeze the stack this branch is for: 0.x is the Vue 2 package for Nuxt 2 sites on Bootstrap 4 and BootstrapVue 2. These move only as a coordinated upgrade, which on this branch there will not be; the next majors are the Druxt 2.x package, not an update to this one.

The Vue 2 test toolchain: @vue/test-utils 1 and @vue/vue2-jest are the last lines for Vue 2, and @vue/vue2-jest needs Jest 29 and Babel 7. Majors are held by the majors rule below; this keeps the reason next to the names.
Node is pinned in .mise.toml, .nvmrc and the pipeline images, and moves as one deliberate change, not as a routine update.
Majors need a human. An automated major lands a breaking change on a branch nobody chose to upgrade.
One pull request for everything else. Ungrouped updates produce a pull request per dependency and the whole set gets ignored together.
